title: Create and launch a split-grid campaign with all zones assigned
description: This verifies that an admin can build a split campaign, assign a playlist to every zone, and launch it successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Select the admin role
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /admin/campaigns
Start creating a campaign
Fill in the campaign name field with a unique campaign name
Fill in valid campaign dates
Select split-grid campaign mode
Select a target screen
Assign a playlist to each split zone
Launch the campaign
Verify the split-screen campaign confirmation is visible
